rules: One helper per source collection. A second helper for the same collection is never listed.
v3 entries are listed only if the deployed code's sha256 equals the sha256 of the published template rendered with that entry's config.
v1 entries are the three helpers live before the grant (built with Rapha / Fak.fun). They predate get-twin-interface and are read through their own getters.
A twin is verified against its helper's finalised canonical record plus the on-chain manifest hash.
